{{Top|leg}}
{{Otheruses|Fisher}}
A '''fisher plant''' was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[F'tral]]. A hostile and predatory plant, the fisher plant draped long tendrils into the [[Water/Legends|water]] to capture prey.
